decisions.D1_line:
windowLine(features, total, cut) in areaWindow.ts: cut -> 'Showing in view, the most drawn at once; move closer to see the rest.'; not cut and every feature of the area drawn -> ' '; not cut, area larger -> ' in view of '. The '(

proposed, not yet confirmed)' note follows the noun in all three. All numbers come from the reads.
decisions.D2_cut: WindowReader publishes (features, cut); cut is true only when the paging loop stopped with a next still pending because the budget was reached. useAreaWindow keeps it in state, returns it, and passes it to windowLine. No extra request.

boxFinding.what: In docs/evidence/runtime/reh5/map-3b.png the box is x 1064-1408, y 564-625, 344 x 61 px, one flat colour (233, 238, 236) = #e9eeec.
boxFinding.colour: #e9eeec is the scene's own ground/clear colour (--ui-map-ground, packages/scene/src/palette.ts:8; engine.ts:204 setClearColor, :304 scene background and fog colour) and also the .canvasWrap background. The inspector's footer in the same picture is (240, 245, 243) = --ui-surface-subtle, so the box is not the inspector.
boxFinding.studioMarkup: A static replica of WindowedArea's markup with the real token, component and module CSS, at 1440 x 900 with the inspector open, puts the inspector at 1060,84 352 x 312 and its footer at y 331, 65 high, the same as the screenshot to the pixel. No element of WindowedArea, InspectorShell, ScaleAndNorth or the key occupies x 1064-1408, y 564-625, at rest or 90 ms into the entry animation.
boxFinding.conclusion: The rectangle is canvas, not markup: a stretch of the 3D view where only the background colour shows (no ground plane or building drawn there). It belongs to packages/scene (engine.ts), which another task owns. Not reproduced here: a live view is needed (no runtime allowed).
boxFinding.nextStep: Reproduce on the Niagara window at 1440 x 900 after a pick and read the scene's draw for that pixel range (ground mesh extent, far plane engine.ts:209, fog engine.ts:1850).
